from_quote: Those of the former are to be the same with those of the electors of the most numerous branch of the State legislatures.
rationale: States the rule of this clause for the electors of the House of Representatives, echoing its words "electors of the most numerous branch of the State legislature."
to_quote: Electors of the most numerous Branch of the State Legislature

from_quote: A representative of the United States must be of the age of twenty-five years; must have been seven years a citizen of the United States; must, at the time of his election, be an inhabitant of the State he is to represent
rationale: Lists the three qualifications for a representative set in this clause: the age of twenty-five years, seven years a citizen, and inhabitant of the State when elected.
to_quote: attained to the Age of twenty five Years, and been seven Years a Citizen of the United States

from_quote: during the time of his service, must be in no office under the United States
rationale: States that a representative "must be in no office under the United States" during his service, echoing the words of the last part of this clause.
to_quote: no Person holding any Office under the United States, shall be a Member of either House

from_quote: The term for which the representatives are to be elected falls under a second view which may be taken of this branch. In order to decide on the propriety of this article, two questions must be considered: first, whether biennial elections will, in this case, be safe
rationale: Takes up "the term for which the representatives are to be elected" and calls it biennial, matching this clause's "chosen every second Year."
